chapters.title: Lily was a friendly girl who…
p: Lily was a friendly girl who liked to help others. One day, she saw a boy who was sad in the park. He had lost his note from his mom. The note said when to go home and what to eat for lunch. Lily wanted to cheer him up, so she gave him a hug and a cookie.

They played together for a while, until Lily saw a piece of paper under a slide. She ran to get it, hoping it was the boy's note. But she did not see the puddle of water on the ground. She slipped and fell into the puddle. She got wet and dirty and hurt her knee.

The boy saw what happened and ran to help her. He took the paper from her hand and looked at it. It was his note! He was so happy and grateful. He thanked Lily and helped her get up. He said he was sorry she slipped and got hurt. He gave her his jacket to keep her warm and dry.

Lily smiled and said it was okay. She was glad she found his note and made him happy. She said he was a good friend. They walked together to the boy's home, where his mom was waiting. She gave them both a hug and a sandwich. She said they were very kind and brave.

Lily and the boy learned that helping others can make you happy, even if you slip and get hurt. They also learned that friendship is a precious gift that can make you feel better. They decided to play together again soon and share more cookies and notes.

chapters.title: Anna and Ben were playing in…
p: Anna and Ben were playing in the sand. They wanted to make a big castle with towers and walls. Anna had a spade and Ben had a bucket. They worked hard and had fun.
"Look, our castle is almost complete!" Anna said. "We just need to make the door and the flag."
"I want to make the door!" Ben said. "You can make the flag."
"No, I want to make the door too!" Anna said. "You always get to do what you want. You are so bossy!"
Anna and Ben started to argue. They both wanted the spade and the bucket. They pulled and pushed and shouted.
"Stop it, you two!" Mom said. She came over and saw the mess. "You are ruining your castle and your friendship. Why can't you share and take turns?"
Anna and Ben felt sorry. They knew Mom was right. They said sorry to each other and hugged.
"Let's finish our castle together," Anna said.
"OK, you can make the door and I'll make the flag," Ben said.
They smiled and used the spade and the bucket to complete their castle. They were proud of their work and their teamwork. Mom took a picture and praised them.
"You are such good builders and good friends," Mom said. "Now, who wants some juice and cookies?"

chapters.title: Tom and Sam are two squirrels…
p: Tom and Sam are two squirrels who live in a big park. They like to play and look for nuts to eat. One day, they see a large nut on a branch. It is bigger than any nut they have ever seen.
"Wow, look at that nut!" Tom says. "It is so large and shiny. I want to eat it."
"Me too," Sam says. "But how can we get it? It is too high and far."
They stare at the nut and think of a way to reach it. They see a long vine hanging from another tree. They have an idea.
"Let's swing on the vine and grab the nut," Tom says.
"OK, let's try," Sam says.
They run to the vine and take turns to swing on it. They stretch their paws and try to catch the nut. But the nut is too large and heavy. It does not move.
"Ouch, this nut is hard," Tom says.
"It hurts my paw," Sam says.
They swing and swing, but they cannot get the nut. They are tired and hungry.
"Let's give up," Tom says. "This nut is not worth it. There are many other nuts in the park."
"OK, let's go," Sam says. "Maybe we can find a smaller and softer nut."

They leave the vine and the large nut. They do not know that the nut is not a real nut. It is a plastic toy that a child left on the branch. They run and play and look for other nuts. They are happy and forget about the large nut.

chapters.title: Lily and Ben are excited They…
p: Lily and Ben are excited. They are going to the park with Mom and Dad. They put on their hats and shoes. They hold hands and march to the car. They sing a song as they march.

At the park, they see a big lake. They see ducks and fish and boats. They run to the edge of the water. They wave to the ducks and the boats. The ducks quack and the boats honk. Lily and Ben laugh and clap.
Mom and Dad call them for a picnic. They march back to the grass. They sit on a blanket and eat sandwiches and fruit. They drink juice and water. They say thank you to Mom and Dad.

After the picnic, they play on the swings and the slide. They make new friends and share their toys. They have fun and are happy. They wave goodbye to their friends and the park. They march to the car and go home. They are tired but still excited. They hug Mom and Dad and say they love them. They go to bed and dream of the park.

chapters.title: Ben and Mia love to go…
p: Ben and Mia love to go to the zoo with their mom and dad. They like to see the animals and learn their names. They have a favorite animal: the parrot. The parrot is famous because it can talk. It can repeat what people say.

One day, they go to the zoo and find the parrot in its cage. They say hello to the parrot and wait for it to talk. But the parrot is quiet. It does not repeat anything. Ben and Mia are sad. They wonder why the parrot is not talking.

They ask their mom and dad. Their mom and dad say that the parrot is shy. It does not like to talk when there are many people around. They say that the parrot needs some time and space to feel comfortable. They say that if they are patient and gentle, the parrot might talk to them.

Ben and Mia decide to try. They sit on a bench near the cage and watch the parrot. They talk to the parrot softly and kindly. They say things like "You are a beautiful parrot" and "We are your friends". They do not yell or make loud noises. They do not touch the cage or throw things at the parrot.

After a while, the parrot starts to move its head and look at them. It opens its beak and makes a sound. Ben and Mia are happy. They listen carefully. The parrot says "Hello, beautiful parrot". It repeats what they said. Ben and Mia clap their hands and laugh. They say "Hello, parrot" and "We are happy to meet you". The parrot repeats them too. It says "Hello, parrot" and "We are happy to meet you". Ben and Mia and the parrot have a fun conversation. They are all happy. The parrot is not shy anymore. It is famous and friendly.

chapters.title: Lily was a little girl who…
p: Lily was a little girl who liked to look at herself in the mirror. She thought she was very pretty and smart. She liked to wear nice dresses and ribbons in her hair. She did not like to share her toys or play with other children. She only wanted to stay in her room and admire herself in the mirror.

One day, her mother made a delicious cake for her birthday. She invited some of Lily's friends to come and celebrate. Lily did not want to go downstairs and join the party. She wanted to stay in her room and eat the cake by herself. She took the cake from the kitchen and ran to her room. She locked the door and put the cake on her bed. She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled. She thought she was the happiest girl in the world.

But then, something strange happened. The mirror started to change. It showed Lily a different image of herself. She saw herself as a greedy and lonely girl. She saw herself with no friends and no fun. She saw herself with a big belly and a sad face. She saw herself growing old and ugly. She was scared and confused. She did not like what she saw. She wanted to see her real self again.

She ran to the door and tried to open it. But it was stuck. She could not get out. She cried and shouted for help. But no one heard her. Everyone was downstairs, having a good time. They did not miss her. They did not know she was in trouble.

Lily realized she had made a big mistake. She wished she had been kind and friendly. She wished she had shared her cake and played with her friends. She wished she had not been so vain and selfish. She wished she had not stayed in her room and looked at the mirror. She learned a hard lesson. She learned that beauty is not everything. She learned that happiness comes from giving and sharing. She learned that staying alone is not good. She learned that staying in the mirror is bad.

chapters.title: Sam and Mia are twins They…
p: Sam and Mia are twins. They like to play in the backyard. But sometimes they fight over toys. One day, they see a big pile of laundry on the grass. It is Mom's laundry. She is hanging it on the line to dry.
"Look, a mountain!" Sam says. He runs to the laundry and jumps on it. He makes a big mess.
"Hey, stop that!" Mia says. She runs after him and tries to pull him off. "You are ruining Mom's clothes!"
"No, I'm not!" Sam says. He pushes Mia away. "It's fun!"
They start to fight. They pull and push and shout. They are fierce. They do not see Mom coming.
"Sam! Mia! What are you doing?" Mom says. She is angry. She sees her laundry all over the ground. Some of it is dirty and torn.
"Sorry, Mom," Sam and Mia say. They look down. They are ashamed.
Mom makes them pick up the laundry and help her wash it again. She tells them to be nice to each other and share their toys. She says fighting is bad.
Sam and Mia hug and say sorry to each other. They promise to be good. They learn their lesson.

chapters.title: Lily loved to sing and dance…
p: Lily loved to sing and dance. She wanted to be a musician when she grew up. She liked to listen to different kinds of music and learn new songs.

One day, her mom took her to a park where there was a band playing. Lily was very excited. She ran to the front and watched the musicians with big eyes. They had guitars, drums, keyboards, and microphones. They played loud and fast music that made Lily want to jump and clap.
"Mom, can I talk to them?" Lily asked. "They are so cool!"
"Sure, honey, but be polite and wait for a break," her mom said.
Lily waited patiently until the band finished a song. Then she walked up to the stage and said, "Hi, I'm Lily. I love your music. You are very good musicians. How do you do that?"

The band smiled and thanked her. They were surprised and happy that a little girl liked their music. They asked her if she liked to sing and dance. Lily nodded and said, "Yes, I do. I want to be a musician too."
"That's awesome, Lily. You are very intelligent and brave to follow your dream," one of them said. "Do you want to join us for a song?"
Lily was thrilled. She nodded again and said, "Yes, please!"

The band gave her a microphone and invited her to the stage. They asked her what song she wanted to sing. Lily chose her favorite song, a nursery rhyme that she knew by heart. The band played along and Lily sang with all her heart. The people in the park clapped and cheered for her. Lily felt very happy and proud. She had made new friends and had fun. She hugged the band and thanked them. They told her to keep singing and dancing and to come back anytime.
Lily ran back to her mom and told her everything. Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm so proud of you, Lily. You are a wonderful musician. You made everyone happy with your music."
Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, mom. I love you. And I love music."

chapters.title: Tom and Lily are twins They…
p: Tom and Lily are twins. They like to play in their house. Sometimes they play with their toys, sometimes they play with their dog, and sometimes they play on the stair.

One day, they decide to play on the stair. They take their pillows and blankets and make a fort. They pretend they are in a castle and they are the king and the queen. They enjoy their game very much.
But their mom is working in her room. She needs to be quiet. She does not like the noise that Tom and Lily make on the stair. She tells them to stop and play somewhere else.
Tom and Lily are sad. They do not want to leave their fort. They do not want to make their mom angry. They think of a way to play on the stair and be quiet.
They find some books and crayons. They sit on the stair and read and draw. They whisper to each other and giggle softly. They enjoy their new game too.
Their mom is happy. She can work in her room and be quiet. She is proud of Tom and Lily for being good and creative. She gives them a hug and a kiss and tells them she loves them.

chapters.title: Lily and Ben are friends They…
p: Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play at the park. There is a big plastic slide at the park. Lily and Ben want to go on the slide.

They run to the slide and take turns to climb the steps. Lily goes first. She sits on the slide and says, "Whee!" She slides down fast and laughs. Ben waits for his turn. He climbs the steps and sits on the slide. He says, "Whee!" He slides down fast and laughs too.

They do it again and again. They have fun. But then they hear a loud noise. It is a big dog. The dog barks and runs to the slide. Lily and Ben are scared. They do not like the dog. The dog jumps on the slide and slides down. He makes the slide dirty and wet.

Lily and Ben run away from the slide. They find their moms and dads. They tell them about the dog. Their moms and dads hug them and say, "It's okay. The dog is gone. You are safe. Do you want to play something else?"

Lily and Ben nod. They do not want to go on the slide anymore. They want to play with the swings and the sandbox. They hold hands and walk to the other side of the park. They are still friends. They are happy.

chapters.title: Ben was a dog who loved…
p: Ben was a dog who loved to swim. He liked to splash in the water and chase the fish. One day, he saw a big lake with many ducks. He wanted to swim with them and have fun.

He ran to the lake and jumped in. The ducks were scared and flew away. Ben felt sad. He wanted to make friends, not scare them. He looked around and saw a distant island. He thought maybe there were more ducks there. He decided to swim to the island.

He swam and swam, but the island was very far. He got tired and cold. His paws hurt and his fur was wet. He wished he had stayed on the shore. He was afraid he would not make it to the island or back to the land.

He saw a boat with a man and a girl. They saw him too. They waved and called him. "Poor dog, he is lost and in trouble. Let's help him," the man said. "Yes, let's. He looks so cute and brave," the girl said. They steered the boat to Ben and lifted him up. They wrapped him in a blanket and gave him some food and water.

Ben was happy and grateful. He licked their faces and wagged his tail. He had found new friends. He learned a lesson. He should not swim too far or chase the ducks. He should be careful and respectful. He should be happy with what he had. He thanked the man and the girl and they took him back to the shore. He ran to his home and told his family about his adventure. They were glad he was safe and smart. They hugged him and played with him. Ben was a happy dog who loved to swim.

chapters.title: Sara and Ben were twins who…
p: Sara and Ben were twins who liked to play in the garden. They saw a big bush with red berries on it. Sara wanted to pick some berries, but Ben was scared of the thorns.
"Come on, Ben, the berries are yummy!" Sara said. She was enthusiastic about the berries. She reached for a branch, but it was too high.
"Help me, Ben!" Sara said. "You can support me and I can get the berries."
Ben shook his head. He did not want to support Sara. He thought the bush was prickly and the berries were sour.
"No, Sara, the bush is bad. It will hurt you and the berries will make you sick. Let's go play with the ball instead." Ben said.
Sara was angry with Ben. She wanted the berries very much. She did not want to play with the ball. She tried to climb the bush by herself, but she slipped and fell. She scraped her knee and cried.
Ben heard Sara cry and ran to her. He felt sorry for Sara. He hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Sara. I should have supported you. Are you okay?"
Sara sniffed and nodded. She hugged Ben back and said, "It's okay, Ben. I should have listened to you. The bush was bad. The berries were not worth it."
Ben smiled and said, "Let's go inside and get a band-aid for your knee. Then we can have some cookies and milk. Maybe we can find some better berries another day."
Sara smiled and said, "Okay, Ben. That sounds good. You are a good brother. I love you."
They held hands and went inside. They were happy again.

chapters.title: Lila and Ben like to play…
p: Lila and Ben like to play with their toys on the carpet. They have cars, dolls, blocks and books. They make noises and stories with their toys. They have fun.
But sometimes the carpet is dirty. Mom says they have to fold the carpet and put it away. She says the carpet has dust and crumbs and hair. She says they have to clean the floor.
Lila and Ben do not like to fold the carpet. It is big and heavy. They have to lift it and bend it and roll it. They have to work hard. They get tired.
They wish they could keep playing with their toys on the carpet. They do not like to clean the floor. They think it is boring.
But they know Mom is right. They know the carpet is dirty. They know they have to help. They love Mom.
So they fold the carpet and put it away. They sweep the floor and wipe the dust. They make the floor shiny and clean.
Mom is happy. She hugs them and kisses them. She says they are good and helpful. She says they can play with their toys on the carpet again tomorrow. She says she loves them.
Lila and Ben are happy. They hug Mom and kiss her. They say they are sorry for the mess. They say they love her too.
They go to their room and play with their toys on the bed. They make noises and stories with their toys. They have fun.

chapters.title: Lila and Sam were playing in…
p: Lila and Sam were playing in the sand. They liked to pretend they were explorers in the desert. They had a big hat, a water bottle and a map.
"Look, Sam, the map says there is an oasis over there!" Lila said, pointing to a green spot on the paper.
"Let's go and see!" Sam said, excited. They got up and started to walk.
But the sun was very hot and the sand was very dry. They felt thirsty and tired. They wished they had a camel to ride.
"Maybe we should crawl, like snakes," Lila suggested. "It might be cooler and faster."
"OK, let's try," Sam agreed. They dropped to their knees and began to crawl on the sand.
They crawled and crawled, but the oasis seemed very far away. They wondered if it was real or just a picture.
"Are we there yet?" Sam asked, panting.
"I don't know," Lila said, squinting. "I think I see something green."
They crawled a little more, and then they saw it. It was an oasis, a small pool of water with some palm trees and grass. It looked like a paradise.
"Wow, we made it!" Lila exclaimed, smiling.
"Yay, we did it!" Sam cheered, clapping.
They ran to the water and splashed their faces. They drank some water and felt refreshed. They saw some brown dates hanging from the trees and picked some to eat. They felt happy and proud.
They decided to rest under the shade of the palms. They spread their hat on the ground and lay down.
"This is the best adventure ever," Lila said, cuddling with Sam.
"I agree," Sam said, closing his eyes. "You are the best explorer ever."
They fell asleep, dreaming of more adventures.

chapters.title: Tim and Sam were brothers They…
p: Tim and Sam were brothers. They liked to play outside in the mud. They had a big red jacket that they shared. They took turns wearing it.
One day, Tim wanted to wear the jacket, but Sam said no. He said it was his turn. They started to fight over the jacket. They pulled and tugged and yelled.
"Stop it!" Mom said. "You are making a mess. Give me the jacket. I will wash it and then you can both wear it."
Tim and Sam did not listen. They kept fighting. They did not see the big hole in the ground. They fell into the hole with the jacket. The hole was full of water. It was very cold and deep.
"Help!" Tim and Sam cried. "We are wet and cold. We can't get out."
Mom heard them. She ran to the hole. She was scared. She tried to reach them, but she could not. She called for help. She hoped someone would come soon.
But no one came. Tim and Sam were stuck in the hole. They were very sad. They wished they had listened to Mom. They wished they had not fought over the jacket. They wished they had been happy.

chapters.title: Lila and Ben are twins They…
p: Lila and Ben are twins. They like to play in the farm with their mom and dad. They see many animals, like cows, sheep, chickens and pigs. The pigs are big and pink. They make loud noises. Lila and Ben think they are funny.

One day, Lila and Ben see a new animal in the farm. It is not big and pink. It is small and brown. It has long hair and sharp teeth. It runs very fast. It is a wild pig. The wild pig is not nice. It scares the other animals. It breaks the fence. It eats the corn.

Lila and Ben are scared too. They run to their mom and dad. They say, "Mom, dad, there is a wild pig in the farm! It is bad! It is mean! Help!" Mom and dad hear them. They see the wild pig. They are not happy. They get a big stick. They chase the wild pig away. They fix the fence. They check the animals.

Lila and Ben hug their mom and dad. They say, "Thank you, mom and dad. You are brave. You are good. We love you." Mom and dad hug them back. They say, "We love you too, Lila and Ben. You are smart. You are safe. You did well." They all go back to the house. They have some milk and cookies. They are happy. The wild pig is gone. The farm is peaceful. The end.

chapters.title: Tim and Lily were playing with…
p: Tim and Lily were playing with their blocks in the living room. They liked to build towers and houses and cars with the blocks. They had many colors and shapes of blocks to choose from.

But Tim wanted to use all the red blocks for his tower. He did not want to share them with Lily. He took the red blocks from Lily's pile and put them on his tower. Lily was angry. She wanted some red blocks too. She tried to take them back from Tim's tower.
"Stop it, Lily!" Tim shouted. "These are my red blocks! Go away!"
"No, Tim!" Lily shouted back. "You are not nice! You have to share the blocks!"
They shouted and pulled and pushed the blocks. They did not listen to each other. They were frustrated.

Then, something happened. Tim's tower was too tall and wobbly. It fell down with a loud crash. The blocks flew everywhere. Some of them hit Tim and Lily. They were in shock. They felt pain and fear. They stopped shouting and started crying.

Mom heard the noise and came to the living room. She saw the mess and the tears. She was not happy. She hugged Tim and Lily and checked if they were hurt. She said, "What happened here? Why were you shouting and fighting? You know you have to share and be kind to each other."
Tim and Lily felt sorry. They said, "We are sorry, Mom. We wanted the red blocks. We were frustrated. We did not mean to make the tower fall."

Mom said, "It's okay to want the red blocks, but you have to ask and wait for your turn. You have many other blocks to play with. You can make beautiful things together. You are brother and sister. You have to love and help each other."
Tim and Lily nodded. They said, "We love you, Mom. We love each other. We will share and be kind."
Mom smiled. She said, "That's good. Now, let's clean up the blocks and start again. What do you want to build?"
Tim and Lily looked at the blocks. They said, "We want to build a rainbow."

chapters.title: Tom and Lily were at the…
p: Tom and Lily were at the park with their mom. They saw a big slide and ran to it. They wanted to ride the slide and have fun.
But there was a woman in front of the slide. She was rude. She did not let Tom and Lily go on the slide. She said, "This is my slide. Go away. You are too small and slow."
Tom and Lily were sad and angry. They did not like the woman. They wanted to ride the slide. They asked their mom for help.
Their mom came to the woman and said, "Excuse me, can you please share the slide with my children? They are waiting nicely and they want to have a turn."
The woman looked at their mom and said, "No, I can't. This is my slide. I paid for it. You and your children are not welcome here. Go find another slide."
Their mom was shocked and mad. She said, "That is not true. This is a public park. The slide is for everyone. You are being very rude and selfish. You need to move and let others play."
The woman did not listen. She said, "No, I won't. This is my slide. You can't make me."
Their mom said, "Yes, I can. I will call the park ranger and he will make you. He will tell you to follow the rules and be nice. Or he will ask you to leave the park."

The woman was scared. She did not want to talk to the park ranger. She did not want to leave the park. She said, "Fine, fine. I will share the slide. But only for a little bit. Then I will come back and ride it again."
She moved away from the slide and let Tom and Lily go on it. Tom and Lily were happy. They thanked their mom and rode the slide. They had fun.
The woman watched them and frowned. She was not happy. She was still rude.

chapters.title: Tom and Sam were brothers who…
p: Tom and Sam were brothers who liked to play in the woods. They had a big axe that they used to chop wood for their fire. One day, they found a big tree that had many branches and nuts. They both wanted to chop it down and take it home.
"I saw it first!" Tom said. "It is my tree!"
"No, it is mine!" Sam said. "I have the axe!"

They began to quarrel and pull the axe from each other. They did not see the big bear that was sleeping under the tree. The bear heard the noise and woke up. He was angry and hungry. He roared and showed his teeth.
Tom and Sam were frightened. They dropped the axe and ran away. They did not want to chop the tree anymore. They wanted to go home and be safe.
The bear sniffed the axe and the tree. He did not like them. He went back to sleep under another tree. He hoped that Tom and Sam would not come back and bother him again.

chapters.title: Ben and Mia were hungry They…
p: Ben and Mia were hungry. They wanted to eat steak for dinner. But Mom said no. She said steak was too big and too hard for them. She said they had to eat soup and bread.
Ben and Mia did not like soup and bread. They liked steak. They were angry at Mom. They said they did not want soup and bread. They said they wanted steak.
Mom was angry too. She said they had to eat what she made. She said they had to be good and say thank you. She said they had to stop being rude and noisy.
Ben and Mia did not stop. They kept saying they wanted steak. They kept making loud noises. They kept throwing their spoons and napkins.
Mom had enough. She said they had to go to their room. She said they had to shut their mouths. She said they had to stay there until they were sorry.

Ben and Mia did not want to go to their room. They did not want to shut their mouths. They did not want to say sorry. They thought Mom was mean and unfair. They thought steak was yummy and soup was bitter.
They went to their room. They slammed the door. They cried and yelled. They said they hated soup and bread. They said they loved steak. They said they wished they had steak.

chapters.title: Anna and Ben were at the…
p: Anna and Ben were at the park with their mom. They saw a vendor with a big cart of balloons. The vendor had many colors of balloons: red, blue, yellow, green, pink, and purple. Anna and Ben wanted a balloon each.
"Mom, can we have a balloon?" Anna asked.
"Sure, sweetie. You can choose one color each. What color do you want?" Mom said.
"I want a pink one!" Anna said.
"I want a blue one!" Ben said.
Mom gave the vendor some money and the vendor gave them a pink balloon and a blue balloon. Anna and Ben were very happy. They thanked the vendor and held their balloons tightly.

They walked around the park, looking at the flowers, the birds, the swings, and the slides. They saw other kids playing with their balloons too. Some kids let their balloons go up in the sky. Anna and Ben did not want to do that. They liked their balloons too much.

But then, a strong wind came and blew their balloons away. Anna and Ben were very sad. They cried and ran after their balloons. But they could not catch them. The balloons flew higher and higher until they disappeared.
"Mom, our balloons are gone!" Anna sobbed.
"I'm sorry, honey. The wind was too strong. Maybe we can get another balloon another day." Mom said.
She hugged Anna and Ben and tried to comfort them. But they still felt very uncomfortable. They missed their balloons a lot. They wished they could hold them again.

chapters.title: Lila and Ben were friends who…
p: Lila and Ben were friends who liked to play on the farm. They liked to run, jump, and pet the animals. One day, they saw a big scale near the barn. They wanted to know how much they weighed.
"Let's go on the scale and see," said Lila.
"OK, but be careful. It looks old and rusty," said Ben.
They climbed on the scale and looked at the numbers. Lila weighed 15 kilos and Ben weighed 16 kilos.
"Wow, we are so big and strong," said Lila.
"Maybe we are bigger than the sheep," said Ben.
They got off the scale and ran to the field where the sheep were grazing. They saw a white sheep with a fluffy coat. They wanted to weigh it too.
"Come here, sheep. We want to play with you," said Lila.
She grabbed the sheep by the wool and tried to drag it to the scale. The sheep did not like that. It kicked and bleated and tried to get away.
"Help me, Ben. This sheep is heavy and stubborn," said Lila.
Ben ran to help Lila. He grabbed the sheep by the legs and pulled. The sheep was flexible and twisted its body. It broke free from Lila and Ben and ran away.
But Lila and Ben did not let go. They fell off the scale and hit their heads on the ground. They started to cry and bleed. The scale was broken too. It made a loud noise and fell apart.
The farmer heard the noise and came to see what happened. He saw Lila and Ben on the ground and the scale in pieces. He was angry and worried.
"What have you done? You hurt yourselves and the sheep and the scale. You are naughty and foolish. Go home and don't come back," he said.

Lila and Ben were scared and sorry. They ran home and told their parents what happened. Their parents were sad and mad. They had to take them to the doctor and pay for the scale. They said they could not play on the farm anymore.
Lila and Ben learned a hard lesson. They should not play with things they don't understand. They should not bother the animals. They should listen to their friends. They should be careful and kind.

chapters.title: Tim and Mia are playing with…
p: Tim and Mia are playing with their toys in the living room. They have cars, dolls, blocks and books. They are having fun and making noises.
"Vroom, vroom, my car is fast!" Tim says.
"My doll is pretty, she has a dress and a hat!" Mia says.
They hear their mom calling them from upstairs. She says it is time for a nap.
"Come on, kids, let's go upstairs and take a nap. You can bring one toy with you," mom says.
Tim and Mia do not want to nap. They want to play more. They look at their toys and feel confused. Which toy should they take upstairs?
"I want to take my car, but I also want to take my blocks. They are colorful and fun," Tim says.
"I want to take my doll, but I also want to take my book. It has pictures and stories," Mia says.
They do not know what to do. They look at each other and have an idea.
"Let's swap!" Tim says.
"OK!" Mia says.
They swap their toys. Tim takes Mia's doll and Mia takes Tim's car. They smile and run upstairs with their toys.
Mom sees them and feels confused. Why did they swap their toys?
"Are you sure you want to take those toys?" mom asks.
"Yes, mom, we are sure. We like to try new things," Tim and Mia say.
They hug mom and go to their beds. They cuddle with their toys and fall asleep. They dream of cars and dolls and blocks and books. They are happy.

chapters.title: Tom and Lily were playing in…
p: Tom and Lily were playing in the backyard. They had a big box of toys and they liked to pretend they were heroes and villains. Tom picked up a toy sword and said, "I am the king and you are the bad dragon. I will fight you with my weapon and save the princess."

Lily did not like this game. She did not want to be a bad dragon. She wanted to be a fairy or a unicorn. She said, "No, Tom, I don't want to play this. I want to play something else. Let me have the wand and the wings."
Tom did not listen to Lily. He said, "No, Lily, you have to play this. This is my game and my weapon. You can't have the wand and the wings. They are mine."

Lily was angry and sad. She did not like Tom's game and she did not like his weapon. She said, "Tom, you are not nice. You are not the king. You are a bully. You can't tell me what to do. You can't have all the toys. You have to share and permit me to play what I want."

Tom was confused and hurt. He did not understand why Lily was angry and sad. He liked his game and his weapon. He thought they were fun and cool. He said, "Lily, I don't understand. Why are you mad at me? I just want to play with you. I am not a bully. I am your brother. You can play what you want, but you have to play with me too."

Lily and Tom looked at each other. They did not know what to say or do. They wanted to play and have fun, but they also wanted to be happy and fair. They did not want to fight or cry. They wanted to be friends and siblings. They put down their toys and hugged each other. They said, "I'm sorry, Tom. I'm sorry, Lily. I love you. Let's play something else. Something we both like."

chapters.title: Tom and Jen were friends They…
p: Tom and Jen were friends. They liked to play in the farm. They saw a big truck. The truck had many beans. The beans were green and round.
"Let's load the beans!" Tom said. He wanted to have fun. He climbed on the truck. He threw some beans to Jen. Jen caught them. She laughed.
"Stop, stop!" a man shouted. He was the farmer. He was angry. He ran to the truck. He wanted to stop Tom and Jen. He saw the beans on the ground. He saw the beans in the air.
"Get down, get down!" he yelled. He grabbed Tom. He pulled him down. He was very mad. He scolded Tom. He said Tom was bad. He said Tom wasted the beans.

Jen was scared. She hid behind the truck. She saw Tom cry. She saw the farmer shout. She wanted to help Tom. She wanted to say sorry. She saw a big lever. The lever was red. It said "dump". She thought it would make the beans go back. She pulled the lever.
The truck made a loud noise. The beans fell down. They fell on Jen. They covered her. They were heavy. They were hard. They hurt her. She screamed. She could not breathe. She could not move.

Tom and the farmer heard Jen scream. They looked at the truck. They saw the beans. They saw Jen's feet. They were scared. They ran to the truck. They tried to move the beans. They tried to save Jen. But it was too late. Jen was gone.
